title: 慢砂濾池建造
summary: 本課以慢砂構造、級配、生物成熟與刮砂復原為主線，從原水適用性與前處理、池體尺寸與材料數量、篩分析與級配驗收、承托與集水均勻性進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops slow-sand construction, grading, biological ripening and scraping recovery through ten connected units, beginning with source suitability and pretreatment, cell geometry and material quantities, sieve analysis and grading acceptance, support and collection uniformity. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

steps.instruction: 承托層與集水系統須避免細砂流失及局部短路，完工檢查應結合分區水頭與流量。
